definitions.explanation: A weight or demand placed on a system, body, or person. Used in technical contexts for mechanical/electrical load, in fitness for physical stress on muscles, and more broadly for any kind of burden.

examples.japanese: ⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{負荷|ふか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The server is under heavy load.

examples.japanese: ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{負荷|ふか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけすぎないようにして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't put too much stress on your knees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負荷|ふか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}している→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧。
examples.english: We are promoting recycling to reduce the burden on the environment.

notes:
USAGE:
{負荷|ふか} is versatile and appears in technical, medical, fitness, and environmental contexts. The most common pattern is {負荷|ふか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (load is applied) and {負荷|ふか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to apply load). In computing, it refers to system load; in exercise, to the intensity of training.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負荷|ふか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: load/stress is applied
- {負荷|ふか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to apply load/stress
- {負荷|ふか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{軽減|けいげん}する→軽減する：25372_keigensuru⟧: to reduce the load
- ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧{負荷|ふか}: high load
- {負荷|ふか}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: load test, stress test
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{負荷|ふか}: environmental burden

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧ (burden, share) is used more for financial or personal burdens. {負荷|ふか} is more technical and physical. ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧ (stress) is the common loanword used in everyday conversation about mental pressure.
